CheckTitle: Dynamic group rules prevent stale access by avoiding the retiring memberOf operator
Description:
This check verifies that dynamic membership groups in Microsoft Entra ID do not use the **memberOf** rule operator (`user.memberof` / `device.memberof`).

Microsoft is retiring this public-preview operator on November 3, 2026. Groups that still use it will stop updating and remain frozen in their last known membership.
Risk: A frozen dynamic group retains every user or device from retirement time and never updates membership. Departed or re-roled members keep app assignments, Teams/SharePoint access, group-based licences, and **Conditional Access** targeting (inclusion or exclusion). This creates a silent, growing access-control gap.

Code.Other:
1. Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center (https://entra.microsoft.com/)
2. Navigate to Identity > Groups > All groups
3. Select the affected dynamic group
4. Open Dynamic membership rules
5. Replace the memberOf expression with attribute-based rules (e.g. user.department, user.extensionAttributeN, user.employeeType)
6. Alternatively, convert the group to Assigned membership under Properties > Membership type
7. Validate the resulting membership and every app, Conditional Access policy, licence, and SharePoint/Teams assignment that uses the group

Recommendation.Text: Replace the **memberOf** operator in dynamic group rules with attribute-based expressions (e.g. `user.department`, `user.extensionAttributeN`) or convert the group to **Assigned** membership before the operator retirement date. Validate all dependent policies and assignments after migration.

Notes: Ported from Maester control MT.1197 (Test-MtDynamicGroupMemberOfRule, MIT licensed). The check does not depend on the current date for PASS/FAIL; the date only changes the wording in status_extended.
